Record labels behave like investors: someone with capital chooses which artist to put it behind. And some of the most successful pop acts were not the best musicians, singers or performers. What I used to tell musician friends is: look at who is actually the talent. Often it was not the performer. It was the production, the access to venues and radio, and above all the songs.
